# Create Multiple HUD Texts that use Player Data and Refresh when players Leave/Join

Source: [4827](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4827); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-4827-n1"></a>

- Example stores every Last Text ID in a global array, detects team-roster changes, destroys tracked texts, clears the array, and recreates per-player HUDs.

<a id="wiki-4827-n2"></a>

- Uses a0.5s wait to let the global cleanup rule run before per-player creation; HUD string reevaluation updates status without recreating the text for each status change.

Source limitations:

- Article explicitly calls this an example that could be improved; fixed-delay ordering is fragile under rapid roster changes and was not tested. Preserve the ownership/cleanup pattern rather than presenting the snippet as a canonical robust implementation.
